content.short: buildspace provides sample web3 projects and a community to build.
content.description: Buildspace is an educational Web3 platform that helps you build sample Web3 projects across a range of lengths and difficulty levels. You join a cohort of peers working on the same project, connected in a Discord server, so you can ask questions, troubleshoot together, and celebrate progress as you go. The environment emphasizes hands-on practice, collaborative debugging, and ongoing support, making it easier to learn practical Web3 skills and complete meaningful projects at your own pace.
content.meta: buildspace offers project-based lessons and a community for learning Web3 development. Discover buildspace and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
